# local-docker

The docker on the operator's machine, whatever runs it there.

## What it emits

Rendered by `crossplane.nop` as the lab unit `host`. A unit of the lab
installs nothing into a cluster, and its provisions are sealed inside the
lab's inclusion — so its declaration above is its interface.
